2: In quadrilateral ABCD, where $|AD|=5\sqrt3$ and $|CD|=6$, a circle can be inscribed. Diagonal BD forms an angle of measure 60° with side AB, and forms an angle whose sine equals $\frac34$ with side AD. Determine the lengths of sides AB and BC, and the length of diagonal BD of this quadrilateral.
7: Segment AB of length 4 lies on the line with equation $y=\frac34x-\frac32$. The perpendicular bisector of segment AB intersects the y-axis at point $P=(0,6)$. Compute the coordinates of the endpoints of segment AB.
9: The remainder of dividing the polynomial $W(x)=6x^3+(m+4)x^2-2x-1$ by the binomial $x-m$ equals 8. Compute the value of $m$ and the roots of this polynomial.
10: The base of a pyramid is a square ABCD with side length 25. The lateral faces ABS and BCS have equal areas, each equal to 250. The lateral faces ADS and CDS also have equal areas, each equal to 187.5. The lateral edges AS and CS have equal lengths. Compute the volume of this pyramid.
11: An urn contains ten balls: 4 white, 3 black, 2 green and 1 blue. Three balls are drawn simultaneously from the urn. Compute the probability of the event that among the drawn balls there are no two balls of the same color. Give the result as an irreducible common fraction.
